stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Dietary fiber serves several functions in the human body. It slows the rate at which sugar enters the bloodstream, helping to prevent sharp spikes in blood glucose. ______ fiber feeds beneficial bacteria in the large intestine, which convert it into compounds that nourish the cells lining the colon.
explanation: The first sentence says fiber has several functions, and the next sentence names one: steadying blood sugar. The sentence after the blank names a second, separate function, which is feeding gut bacteria. Both point the same way, and the second is a new item of the same kind, so you need an addition word. If you put 'and also' between the two sentences, it reads naturally. 'Additionally' fits.

A.why: You read the second function as a result of the first. Feeding gut bacteria isn't caused by slowing sugar absorption. They're two independent jobs, so a cause-and-effect word doesn't fit.

C.why: You took a change of subject, from the bloodstream to the intestine, for a contradiction. The second function doesn't argue against the first. It's another entry in the list the passage promised.

D.why: 'Specifically' would mean the next sentence restates the glucose point more precisely. Instead it introduces a different function, so it adds a point rather than zooming in on the one before.

subtype_name: Adding another point, or doubling down (In addition / Moreover / Indeed)

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Researchers excavating a hilltop storehouse in southern Anatolia have recovered pottery that is unusually well preserved for its age. The dry, sealed room protected the vessels from moisture for centuries. ______ several of the jars, though roughly 3,000 years old, still contain traces of the olive oil once stored in them.
explanation: The passage claims the pottery is unusually well preserved. Jars that still hold traces of oil after 3,000 years are vivid evidence for that same claim. This sentence doesn't add a separate point. It strengthens the one already made, so 'Indeed' is the right choice.

A.why: This is the trap. The phrase 'though roughly 3,000 years old' sounds like a contrast, so you reached for a contrast word. But the sentence as a whole confirms the main claim about preservation. A surprising sentence isn't the same as one that disagrees.

B.why: 'Instead' means one thing replaces another. The oil traces don't replace anything in the earlier sentences. They support what those sentences say.

C.why: 'Afterward' marks a later step in time. The passage isn't describing a sequence of events. It's backing up a claim with evidence.

subtype_name: Adding another point, or doubling down (In addition / Moreover / Indeed)

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: Mapmaker Ilse Varga's 1922 survey of a river delta was valued by two very different groups. River pilots relied on its depth soundings to steer barges through shifting channels. ______ botanists used its careful marking of reed beds to track how plant communities moved from year to year.
explanation: The first sentence promises two groups that valued the survey. The pilots are the first group, and the botanists after the blank are the second. Because the sentence adds a new, parallel item pointing the same way, you need an addition word. 'Moreover' fits.

B.why: You treated the botanists' use as a result of the pilots' use. The two groups used different features of the map for unrelated reasons, so nothing here is caused by what came before.

C.why: You heard 'very different groups' and expected a contrast. The groups differ, but the sentences agree: both show the survey being valued. Nothing is being conceded or reversed.

D.why: 'That is' restates the previous sentence in other words. The botanists sentence doesn't restate the pilots sentence. It names the second group.

subtype_name: Adding another point, or doubling down (In addition / Moreover / Indeed)

stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
stimulus: A brayer, the small hand roller found in nearly every printmaking studio, has more than one use. Most often, it spreads ink in a thin, even layer across the carved surface of a block. ______ many artists roll a clean brayer over paper laid on an inked block, pressing the image onto the sheet without a press.
explanation: The first sentence says the brayer has more than one use. The second gives the most common one, inking the block. The sentence after the blank gives another use, pressing paper onto the block. This is a separate item of the same kind, so you need an addition word. 'In addition' fits.

A.why: You read the second use as replacing the first. The passage says the brayer has more than one use, so artists do both. 'Instead' would wrongly suggest they stop inking with it.

B.why: You treated the second use as a consequence of the first. Pressing paper doesn't follow from spreading ink. It's simply another job the tool does.

D.why: 'Namely' introduces a more precise version of what was just said. The sentence after the blank doesn't sharpen the inking description. It names a different use.
